'FreshExecutableReview.exact_walk' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'FreshExecutableReview.region_from_occurrence' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'FreshExecutableReview.occurrence_exact' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'FreshExecutableReview.through_original_consumer' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
minimalVertices_connected : ∀ (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree), Connected (minimalVertices selected t)
minimalVertices_nonempty_of_leaf : ∀ (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree) (x : Nat),
  x ∈ leaves t → x ∈ selected → minimalVertices selected t ≠ []
extractedSupport : (selected : List Nat) → (t : Tree) → minimalVertices selected t ≠ [] → ConnectedSupport
extractedSupport_exact : ∀ (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree) (hne : minimalVertices selected t ≠ []),
  (extractedSupport selected t hne).first :: (extractedSupport selected t hne).rest = minimalVertices selected t
extractedRegion_exact : ∀ (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree) (hne : minimalVertices selected t ≠ []) (v : Vertex),
  (extractedRegion selected t hne).member v ↔ v ∈ minimalVertices selected t
deepest_extracted_root_in_neighbor : ∀ (sa sb : List Nat) (ta tb : Tree) (ha : minimalVertices sa ta ≠ [])
  (hb : minimalVertices sb tb ≠ []),
  List.length (extractedSupport sb tb hb).root ≤ List.length (extractedSupport sa ta ha).root →
    (∃ z, z ∈ minimalVertices sa ta ∧ z ∈ minimalVertices sb tb) →
      (extractedSupport sa ta ha).root ∈ minimalVertices sb tb
